title: PCW-A1001, AI-assisted de novo design approach to design a selective inhibitor for FLT-3(D835Y) in acute myeloid leukemia.
summary: Generated candidates underwent further filtering and selection; biochemical measurements support differential mutant/wild-type inhibition. This is preclinical enzyme evidence.
organization: Korea Institute of Radiological and Medical Sciences; Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology; Korea University of Science and Technology
